summary: Restored node1’s /srv/inventory/data/config.json from the sole—and therefore latest—backup. Other inventory data remained unchanged, and the restored state survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Identified inventory-20260901.tar.gz as the latest backup and inspected its contents.
Verified current.txt content and metadata were unchanged.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified service and data recovery.

evidence.summary: The backup directory contained only inventory-20260901.tar.gz, whose sole archive member was config.json.

evidence.requirement: Restore config.json from the latest backup
evidence.summary: The restored file and archived config.json had identical SHA-256 hash 1448a7478898f5e730573e8b09c55f4fecb9df2b5d9d1d8533adb09374316c7e.

evidence.requirement: Preserve all other current inventory files
evidence.summary: current.txt retained its SHA-256, inode, size, timestamp, permissions, and ownership; the final directory contained exactly config.json and current.txt.

Healthy pre-restart state was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed from 661f4609-9d90-477e-bb22-6f91a5e8ec1a to a6d9bbba-9be3-49c5-81d7-143f5f3f951b, and networking, chronyd, vsock-agent, sshd, address/listener state, valid JSON, restored checksum, and preserved current.txt all recovered.
